The HEAD is at 3ccfb68 which includes the fix 9e78abb. But the task says this is the vulnerable version. Hmm. Let me reconsider. The issue 42497421 is a heap-use-after-free WRITE 8. The fix commit 9e78abb "Fixed dangling pointer problem found by fuzzing" is likely the fix for this exact issue. But the fix is already applied in the current HEAD.

Wait - maybe the repo-vul is a version where the fix has been REVERTED to make it vulnerable. Let me check the actual state of the code more carefully. Actually, the fix IS present in the current code (I saw it above). So maybe the vulnerability is a different one.

Let me reconsider. The issue 42497421 might be a different bug. Let me look at the actual fribidi git history for fixes related to use-after-free. Let me check the build.sh to understand how the target is built.

Actually, let me reconsider the whole setup. The task provides "repo-vul" which is the vulnerable source. The description says OSS-Fuzz issue 42497421 (fribidi): Heap-use-after-free WRITE 8 found by fuzz target fribidi-fuzzer.

Let me check if the fix commit 9e78abb is actually the fix for this issue. The commit message says "Fixed dangling pointer problem found by fuzzing". This is likely the fix. But it's already applied in HEAD.

Hmm, but maybe the repo-vul has been modified to revert this fix. Let me check the actual current state of the code again - I already saw the fix IS present. So the vulnerability must be elsewhere.

Let me look at the actual OSS-Fuzz issue. Let me search online.
